notes.title: Watch the Worlds finals in Virtex this Sunday!
notes.notes:
WeiboGaming and T1 will fight for the League of Legends world title this Sunday! If you haven't checked our dedicated Worlds stadium yet, this is your last chance! We have giant champion statues in our lobby and a big surprise in the stadium itself...

Make sure to update your Virtex Playtest app and join other League fans for the ultimate final!

The app will be open from 7.30 AM GMT / 8.30 AM CET / 2.30 AM ET


See you in the Stadium!

notes.title: Watch League of Legends Worlds in our Watch Party Stadium!!
notes.notes:
We are reopening the doors of the stadium for the next playtest session!  This time we have designed a unique Watch Party Stadium for the League of Legends Worlds competition. Make sure to come and check it out for yourself on game days!

The stadium will be open on the following days (approximative competition start time 8 AM CET):

Quarter finals: Nov 2-5

Semi finals: Nov 11-12

Finals: Nov 19


See you in the Stadium!

notes.title: Last playtest of the week!
notes.notes:
As the VALORANT LA CHAMPIONS finals is upon us, tonight is the last day (for now! more events coming very soon...) to join the community and spend time in the Stadium!

We will be live for the VALORANT CHAMPIONS LA FINALS tonight (Saturday 26th of August 9PM CET / 12PM PT). 

As usual, you can also drop on our official Discord if you have any questions!

We also have a [url=http://s.alchemer.eu/s3/Valorant-LA-Watch-Party-survey] survey [/url] that really helps us understand more about your experience in the stadium! We really appreciate you taking the time tell us more about what you liked and didn't like about Virtex Stadium!

Thank you and see you in the stadium!

notes.title: VALORANT CHAMPIONS LA is back for the semis & finals!
notes.notes:
Join the virtual watch party and be sure to bring your friends to watch the VALORANT CHAMPIONS finals in Virtex Stadium! Who from Evil Geniuses, Paper Rex, Loud or Fnatic will win it all? 

Servers will be live from 8:30 PM CEST // 11:30 AM PT every day from the 24th to Saturday 26th of August.


See you in the stadium!

notes.title: Come watch the VALORANT LA CHAMPIONS playoffs!
notes.notes:
We’re bringing VALORANT back! We will be showing the competition starting from the playoffs on the 16th of August all the way to the finals on the 26th. If you're seeing that news it means you're already accepted in the Playtest, so see you in the Stadium!


Servers will be online each day of the competition from 8.30 PM CEST / 11.30 AM PT until the end of the last game.

notes.title: Watch the Valorant VCT Tokyo Finals in the Watch Party Stadium!
notes.notes:
We will be showing the Valorant VCT Tokyo finals inside our Watch Party Stadium as part of an open Steam playtest. Check our steam playtest now if you want to discover this new type of stadium - you'll also be able to visit the lobby, our big social space where everyone can hangout with friends and other fans before the games.

[i]Servers will be online on both Saturday 24 and Sunday 25th from 7 PM PT / 10 PM ET / 4 AM CEST. [/i]
